caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object is an oval-shaped plaque or ornament that features the relief of a bird perched on a branch. The bird and the plaque are rendered in shades of gray and brown, suggesting a metallic or weathered stone texture. There are green leaves accenting the area around the bird and branch, adding a contrasting color element to the predominantly neutral tones. The plaque itself has some decorative patterning along its edge. The artist's signature, "BEN YASSEN," is faintly written in pencil in the lower right quadrant of the drawing. There are no other objects or decorations present, and the background remains unadorned.
title: Door Knocker
